question: What is the distance of the penalty mark from the midpoint of the goal post in football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Soccer** is another name for** football**. The competition's rules will determine whether **natural or artificial surfaces **can be used for matches. **Artificial surfaces** are **green** in colour.
 
• At a distance of **16.5 metres from the interior of each goalpost, two lines are drawn perpendicular to the goal line.** A line drawn parallel to the **goal line **connects these lines, which extend 16.5m into the playing field. The **penalty area **is the region enclosed by these lines and the goal line.
 
• A **penalty mark is placed 11 metres from and equally spaced from the goalposts **in each penalty area.
 
• Outside of the penalty area, a circle with a radius of **9.15m is drawn with its centre** at each penalty mark.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Association football **also referred to as** football or soccer**, is a **team sport **that is **played between two teams of 11 players each**.
 
• During the game, the** players mostly use their feet to kick the ball around a rectangular surface known as a pitch**.
 
• The **purpose of the game is to score more goals than your opponent's team **by moving the ball into a goalpost that is being defended by your opponent's team.
 
• The game has often been** divided into two 45-minute halves for a total game time of 90 minutes**.
